data.name: Hero_Title
data.value: Rapid Own Source Revenue Analysis for Sustainable Cities

data.name: Hero_Subtitle
data.value: ROSRA helps local governments estimate OSR improvement potential, diagnose where revenue is being lost, prioritize reform areas and access practical reform guidance.

data.name: Flow_Body
data.value: ROSRA starts with a quick estimate of the overall room for own-source revenue improvement. It then moves into a stream-level diagnosis, breaking down where revenue is being lost across coverage, compliance, and liability or valuation gaps. The tool then helps users prioritize which issues to address first and points them to practical reform guidance. The final output is a ROSRA Diagnostic Report.

data.name: Methodology_QuickAnalysis_Alt
data.value: Quick Analysis showing the Kampala Local Government Profile and a top-down WoFi estimate of own-source revenue potential vs current collection

data.name: Methodology_QuickAnalysis_Body
data.value: Before diving into stream-by-stream detail, ROSRA produces a top-down snapshot. The city fills in a one-screen Local Government Profile — country, financial year, currency, current OSR, regional GDP and population — and the WoFi estimator benchmarks the city against peer subnational governments globally. In seconds you see today's revenue, the estimated revenue potential, the gap between them, and a frontier index that places the city on the global revenue-effort scale. It's the orientation step: it tells the reform team how much headroom they're working with before they pick which streams to dig into.

data.name: Methodology_Step1_Alt
data.value: Gap Analysis dashboard showing the Kampala Daily Market Fee matrix and revenue vs potential breakdown

data.name: Methodology_Step1_Body
data.value: For each revenue stream, the city enters only the inputs in the gray-shaded cells — registered units, billed amount, outstanding amount, statutory benchmark — and ROSRA decomposes the gap between current collection and full potential into specific drivers: Compliance, Coverage, Valuation or Liability, and the mixed gaps that combine them. The matrix dashboard on the right makes it instantly visible where each shilling is slipping through. Streams that don't apply to your context can be excluded.

data.name: Methodology_Step2_Alt
data.value: Stream Prioritization table showing each Kampala revenue stream ranked by total functional gap

data.name: Methodology_Step2_Body
data.value: Streams are ranked by their Total Functional Gap and broken down per gap-type — Compliance, Coverage, Valuation/Liability, and the mixed gaps — in a single stacked bar so the city can see at a glance which reforms move the most revenue. Decision-makers can re-order, exclude, or remove specific gap-types that aren't politically feasible. Excluded streams (like Solid Waste Fee here) are dropped from rank, share, the bar chart, and the downstream Reform Guidance — the plan respects local realities, not just the math.

data.name: Methodology_Step3_Alt
data.value: Reform Guidance — solution cards with implementation guidance

data.name: Methodology_Step3_Body
data.value: From a curated library of evidence-based solution cards, ROSRA narrows the list by stream, gap-type, timeline, and political feasibility — and a 3-question personaliser tailors them to the city's context. Each card explains what the option does, most useful when, usually not the best first move when, and often works best alongside. The right-hand Selection Summary tracks every pick by stream and gap so the city ends up with a coherent reform package.

data.name: Methodology_Step4_Alt
data.value: Step 4 Recommendations — consolidated action plan with timelines and quick-win tags

data.name: Methodology_Step4_Body
data.value: The selected solutions are consolidated into a single implementation plan, grouped by stream and ranked by priority, with each card timeline-tagged as a Quick Win (<1 year), Medium Term (1–3 years), or Long Term (3+ years). Switch between Solution Cards, Timeline View, and Progress Tracker views — then export the whole plan to PDF or HTML as the city's tailored Revenue Enhancement Action Plan.
